data.revised_prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1536x1024 landscape, for Glacier Signal Chinese stock evaluation workbench. Make it feel like an open boxed-software reference manual, not a documentation website, not a device mockup. Scene: a precise task interface built from an open manual spread with punched translucent overlays and colored edge tabs, two-frame hinged visual cues, compact header, fast scanability. Warm reference-paper ground in #F3EAD9, milk acetate translucent layers, chrome yellow active board #F6C62E, oxide orange #E56B2F, teal #149E9B, ultramarine accents, dark ink #171817. Left page/area features stock identity prominently: exact text “贵州茅台” and “600519.SH”, with a dominant yellow current-result divider reading exact text “等待转强” and “71 / 100”. Include a transparent overlay panel for hard filters and score details, with calm readable Chinese body type in condensed sans headings. Right side must show edge tabs with exact text: “硬性过滤”, “评分明细”, “仓位方案”, “模型依据”, using colored tabs. Risk output visible on the right, with exact text “结构止损 ¥1,198.00”. Lower content should start already in the viewport, showing the top of additional analysis sections below the fold. Overall aesthetic: precise, industrial, tactile, and readable; no generic bento cards, no cream-and-serif editorial cliché, no invented claims, no watermark. Include exact text “Glacier Signal” in the compact header. Layout should be dense but clean, with layered translucent overlays, punched holes, hinge cues, and tabbed reference-manual mechanics.
